reference_vehicle.usage: Protocol geometry and test-condition evidence only; no manufacturer-specific CrashVector vehicle is implied.

test_condition.impact: moderate-overlap frontal impact into deformable barrier

published_observations.notes: Version II specifies 64.4 ± 1 km/h and 40 ± 1 percent overlap. CrashVector stores only the public protocol condition here; no IIHS rating, dummy injury measure, or intrusion outcome is used as a CrashVector acceptance corridor.

scope.required_model_gap: The IIHS deformable barrier face and validated 40-percent overlap alignment are not implemented as a production protocol target.
scope.warning: This reference records the IIHS test condition only. It does not mean CrashVector results are IIHS-correlated or suitable for ratings, injury prediction, or vehicle-specific safety assessment.
